matching_rule.title_or_identifier: title similarity >=0.99; for DBLP CoRR records derived from the exact arXiv identifier, the immutable arXiv ID may prove identity across a title revision
matching_rule.authors: same first-author surname and at least 80% surname overlap; this tolerates canonical name changes and version author additions; output uses DBLP's complete canonical list
matching_rule.bibtex_hash: sha256 of live DBLP BibTeX after stripping timestamp/biburl/bibsource and replacing alias key
